Below is a quick‑start recipe so you can fire off the “Vote – Malicious” call yourself against **VirusTotal**. (If you’re already running a script or Postman collection, copy/paste the relevant parts.) --- ### 1️⃣ Build the Request | Element | What It Is | |---------|------------| | **Endpoint** | `POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` | | **Headers** | • `x-apikey: `
• `Content-Type: application/json` | | **Body** | ```json\n{ \"type\": \"vote\", \"attributes\": { \"verdict\": \"malicious\" } }\n``` | *Your key (`key_four`) goes straight into the `x-apikey` header.* --- #### Example – Command Line (cURL) ```bash curl --request POST \ --url "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" \ --header "x-apikey: key_four" \ --header "content-type: application/json" \ --data '{ "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" }}' ``` #### Example – Python (requests library) ```python import requests headers = { "x-apikey": "key_four", "content-type": "application/json" } payload = { "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" } } response = requests.post( url="https://www.virustool.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes", json=payload, headers=headers ) print(response.status_code) # Expect 200 OK on success print(response.json()) # Response body contains details about the created vote ``` *(Replace `"key_four"` with whatever value you stored under that name.)* --- ### 2️⃣ Verify Success A successful vote returns something along the lines of: ```json { "_id": "some_vote_id", "created_at": "...", "updated_at": "...", "type": "vote", "links": {...}, "relationships": {...} } ``` HTTP status code **201 Created** (or sometimes **200 OK**) indicates the vote was accepted. --- ### 3️⃣ Common Pitfalls & Tips | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | *401 Unauthorized* | Double‑check that `key_four` is exactly what’s returned when you generate a new API key in the VT dashboard. No extra spaces! | | *404 Not Found* | Ensure the IP address is correctly typed (`22.242.75.136`). If you accidentally hit `/domains/...`, you’ll see a 404. | | *429 Too Many Requests* | You’ve exceeded your rate limit. Pause for a minute before retrying. | | *400 Bad Request* | Confirm the JSON structure matches the spec above—no stray commas, proper quoting, etc. | --- ### 4️⃣ Next Steps Once the vote lands, you can verify its presence by querying the same IP resource again: ```bash curl --get \ --url "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136" \ --header "x-apikey: key_four" ``` Look inside the returned JSON for a section similar to: ```json "last_votes": [ { "verdict": "malicious", ... }, … ] ``` That confirms your vote has been recorded. Happy hunting—and thanks for keeping the community safe! 🚀
